exposure: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation combined with hysteroscopy
cohort: The study included 120 patients diagnosed with uterine incision defect after cesarean section (PCSD) enrolled from February 2022 to February 2023.
finding: Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation combined with hysteroscopy significantly improved menstrual recovery, relieved TCM symptoms, reduced the recurrence rate, and accelerated wound healing in PCSD patients compared to hysteroscopy alone.
